scope: Measure existing capture publications, store notifications and React commits; no runtime extraction or sampling changes.

reviewedPhase0.evidenceStatus: Parent supplied matching Phase 0 PASS and Phase 1A scope; no release or hardware authorization.

timingRationale: Bounded first baseline on an active user workstation: 20 s rather than a recommended 60 s steady window. Limited steady-state evidence; no long-run, thermal, endurance or hardware claim. All 30 planned runs and cleanup remain subject to a 30 min batch ceiling.

units.durations: ms unless a field says otherwise
units.bytes: bytes; 64 MiB encoded snapshot ceiling checked after each bounded run, 250 MiB retained compressed/evidence artifacts, 2 GiB minimum available disk
units.inputHz: nominal synthetic source pacing, never measured RF or guaranteed delivery rate

conditions.intent: Product demo; inputHz 0 means no serial fixture, not zero demo samples.
conditions.denominator: Demo has no independently delivered serial-frame cohort; unavailable fixture completeness is null.

conditions.intent: One deterministic synthetic serial port; idle telemetry view.
conditions.denominator: Independent delivered fixture IDs intersect actual valid subscription intervals.

conditions.intent: Same idle path at 50 Hz nominal fixture pacing.
conditions.denominator: Independent delivered fixture IDs intersect actual valid subscription intervals.

conditions.intent: One synthetic port and synthetic video with local stick-overlay recording active before warmup.
conditions.denominator: Window cohort intersects actual recording acceptance gates; full Session count is a different denominator.

conditions.intent: Two independent synthetic ports; current-channel switches and internal navigation.
conditions.denominator: Per port, consumer and labelled lifecycle phase; inactive view is not assumed to mean inactive subscription.

conditions.intent: Pause, resume, return to demo and explicit fixture/component cleanup.
conditions.denominator: Per labelled phase and actual subscription lifetime; paused/no-subscription periods do not create expected raw samples.

N.purpose: Ordinary production baseline with independent fixture ledger and common CDP observations. The fixture deliberately requests setup on, but the compiled-out ordinary build must still expose no measurement bridge.

P0.purpose: Profiling build and wrappers present, trace collector off; measures build/instrumentation baseline separately.

P1.purpose: Bounded in-page event collector and React Profiler callbacks enabled.

buildContract.normalBuildCommand: FPV_MEASUREMENT_BUILD=0 NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build
buildContract.profilingBuildCommand: FPV_MEASUREMENT_BUILD=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build -- --profile
buildContract.profilingClientFlag: NEXT_PUBLIC_FPV_MEASUREMENT=true only in the dedicated measurement build
buildContract.traceSetup: window.__fpvMeasurementSetup = { mode: on|off, maxEvents: 200000, runId } before application scripts
buildContract.profileSource: In-page profiler event timeline; no extra full CDP trace in the formal comparison.
buildContract.runtimeReactVersionSource: Observe version in the actual Next app runtime; installed react/package.json is not sufficient for vendored React.
buildContract.generatedFileBoundary: Next profiling build transiently rewrites tracked next-env.d.ts to the measurement distDir. Record that change; the ordinary build runs last so the final tracked state is checked clean before formal measurements.

clockAndCohort.clock: real performance.now in the measured page realm
clockAndCohort.t0: Page-clock boundary after 5 s warmup, with preconditions established.
clockAndCohort.t1: Actual page-clock end boundary after the planned windowMs wait for steady scenarios; report actual elapsed duration. Lifecycle scenarios use explicit actual per-phase boundaries.
clockAndCohort.fixtureIdentity: Source/port plus monotonically assigned independent fixtureFrameId; never derive identity from product sequence.
clockAndCohort.deliveryBasis: Only ledger-confirmed delivered frames whose page-clock delivery time falls in the cohort; planned ticks and delivered frames are separate counts.
clockAndCohort.drain: At t1 freeze the cohort by actual delivery in [t0,t1), then allow a bounded 3 s processing drain while input transport continues in steady S1/S2. Preserve in-flight and later arrivals, but exclude their IDs from this cohort only by the predeclared delivery-time rule. Do not pause transport for steady-state drain; S4 pauses only in its explicit lifecycle phase.
clockAndCohort.subscriptionDenominator: Expected IDs = delivered cohort intersect each consumer's actual valid subscription intervals; report mounts/unmounts and interval boundaries.
clockAndCohort.recordingDenominator: Expected recorded IDs additionally intersect actual recording acceptance gate intervals, independent of raw/UI subscription denominators.
clockAndCohort.lateOrMissing: Drain expiry reports unresolved/missing/late explicitly. Preserve all ledger entries, including in-flight arrivals outside the cohort; do not drop records or move the cohort boundaries to improve results.
clockAndCohort.lifecycle: S3/S4 phase-level windows and denominators remain separate from steady 20 s ratios; report the actual phase timings.

fixtureObserverModes.contrast: P1-P0 adds only product collector and profiler callback recording; the bounded fixture ledger, aggregate counters and before/after CDP observation do not change.

profilerSemantics.phaseMeaning: React mount/update/nested-update callback phase; callback count is not browser FPS. Keep phase and event index with every callback.
profilerSemantics.commitIdentity: Raw per-profiler callback count is primary. workbench callback count describes measured-subtree commits within that boundary only, not all page/root commits. Do not deduplicate callbacks by timestamp.
profilerSemantics.durationMeaning: actualDuration is React measured render work for that boundary; nested durations overlap and must not be summed as total CPU. baseDuration is React's estimate, not measured baseline CPU.
profilerSemantics.coverage: Record each boundary's actual scope. workbench is the measured subtree, not a guarantee of all page roots, portals or independent bridge activity.
profilerSemantics.windowBasis: Select React callbacks by commitTime in [t0,t1), not the later collector event.timeMs. Preserve callback collection time separately.
profilerSemantics.timestampAssociation: Distinct commitTime values are an association aid, not a collision-free commit identity. Preserve all callbacks and flag repeated workbench commitTime values as ambiguous.

perRun: product counters or null with reason
per-profiler callback counts, workbench measured-subtree count and timestamp ambiguity
common CDP endpoint counters, bracket duration including drain, derived deltas or explicit unavailability
read.batch chunk/byte counts and parser.frame counts by command/error, separately from RC decoded cohort
reporting.overhead: Pair N/P0/P1 within the same repeat and condition: P0-N reports profiling-build/wrapper baseline overhead; P1-P0 adds product collector and profiler callback recording. Fixture detailed=false, bounded input ledger, aggregate counters and common CDP before/after observations stay the same in every mode. Use each metric's own declared duration; compare only independently available metrics.
reporting.unavailable: Use null plus unavailable reason, not zero. No trace in N/P0 is intentional unavailability, not zero notifications/commits.
reporting.aggregation: Retain all planned, failed, partial and exploratory runs; report per-run values and repeat summaries. Never select only fastest or passing runs.
reporting.limits: No performance improvement, long-duration stability, device safety or cloud integration claim follows from this baseline.

resources.serverOwnership: scripts/run-phase1a-batch.mts owns one server PID/process group on configured loopback port 3124, switches N/P categories sequentially according to run-index, and never runs both categories concurrently. Actual port availability and bounded cleanup require validation before formal execution.
resources.browserProfile: Fresh isolated context; never attach to user Chrome.
resources.recordingStorage: Synthetic local isolated browser storage; no user directory or original media.
resources.diskGate: Check available disk before the batch and each run; stop if below minDiskFreeBytes.
resources.artifactBudgetIncludes: All retained bytes under this isolated worktree's output/playwright, including prior failed/successful explorations, formal runs, prerequisites, summaries, compressed traces and build/server logs. A fresh batch directory does not reset the 250 MiB allowance. Temporary raw snapshot/compression peak is reported separately and remains subject to available disk checks.
resources.traceMemoryBoundary: Primary collector cap is 200000 fixed-schema events, not a byte/heap cap. No per-frame JSON.stringify; encoded snapshot size is checked after the bounded run.
resources.artifactEncoding: gzip for retained JSON traces; retain rawBytes and compressedBytes in receipts. Other retained evidence also counts toward maxOutputBytes.
resources.heapThreshold: maxHeapBytes is null until an actual observable and justified process/heap threshold is established; no heap-bound claim follows from event count or encoded bytes.

batchStopsOn: product integrity failure: unexpected raw loss, duplication, order or cross-source mixing after declared denominator and drain
event count cap reached/overflow, or encoded snapshot exceeds 64 MiB when checked after a bounded run
unexpected external request or attempted user-data upload
cleanup deadline or unresolved owned process/resource
stopPolicy.result: partial; retain original evidence and reason, stop dependent runs, no optimistic pass.
stopPolicy.cleanup: Deadline is 20 s; timeout does not prove cancellation or release. Keep the owned-resource handle/quarantine evidence if cleanup is unresolved.
stopPolicy.runnerDeadline: Child measurement work maxRunMs=120000; parent runner deadline is maxRunMs + cleanupMs=140000 but no later than batchWorkDeadline. batchWorkDeadline = batchStarted + maxBatchMs - cleanupMs reserves the final 20 s for owned-process cleanup inside the 30 min batch ceiling.

execution.runnerStatus: CLI and bounded process-group cleanup source reviewed; six P1 and four P0/N exploratory controls observed. Frozen protocol awaits root commit, exact-source checks/build receipts and formal execution.
execution.formalGate: Frozen plan must be committed before formal execution; external receipts bind actual plan hash/commit, tested source/tree/file manifest and build IDs. Formal status does not itself prove those subsequent steps completed.
execution.individualRunCommandTemplate: node --experimental-transform-types --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/measure-phase1a.mts --plan benchmarks/capture/measurement-plan.json --normal-url http://127.0.0.1:3124/ --profile-url http://127.0.0.1:3124/ --output output/playwright/phase1a-<batch-id> --run-index <zero-based-plan-index>
execution.exploratoryCommandTemplate: node --experimental-transform-types --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/measure-phase1a.mts --plan benchmarks/capture/measurement-plan.json --normal-url http://127.0.0.1:3124/ --profile-url http://127.0.0.1:3124/ --output output/playwright/phase1a-exploratory-<batch-id> --exploratory --condition S1-100 --mode P1
execution.serverPrecondition: The lower-level runner does not own/start/stop servers. For a direct exploratory run, its caller starts exactly one matching N or P server and owns its cleanup. Formal orchestration selects the category and invokes one --run-index at a time.
execution.nodeArgumentReason: The runner imports TypeScript requiring transformation, not only erasable-type stripping; the orchestrator must pass the same transform flag to owned runner processes.
execution.sourceGateEveryRun: Before every formal run, verify HEAD still equals the batch source SHA and git status --porcelain remains empty; stop partial if source changes. Initial source-linked BUILD_ID receipts remain required.

positiveControl: Dedicated profiling runtime produces genuine React Profiler callbacks with declared fields.
P0 uses the same profiling build but does not collect trace; N exposes no measurement bridge.
Independent fixture IDs reconcile against valid subscriptions and recording gates.
Runtime React, actual browser version, headless state and viewport are observed; GPU backend is observed or explicitly unavailable.
Collector budgets and ordinary-build isolation are verified without user input or external requests.

A preserved final-source/build positive-control receipt binds genuine mount/update callback examples, raw artifact SHA and build identity; earlier exploratory summaries are not silently reused after source/analyzer changes.

runtimeFieldsToFreeze.normalRuntimeReactVersionUnavailableReas: N ordinary build correctly exposes no measurement bridge. The N control artifacts contain no direct React runtime version observation; installed package version is not substituted.

boundaryCoverageObserved.countSemantics: Raw per-profiler callback count; nested boundaries overlap. Counts/examples below span each complete exploratory capture, not just its measurement cohort.

runtimeFieldsToFreeze.serverPortUnavailableReason: Configured frozen endpoint is 3124; these raw exploration artifacts do not store origin/port. Formal orchestrator must bind its owned server PID/port in the external receipt.

collectorByteBudgetEnforcement.caveat: Under-limit runs do not prove cap-trigger behavior or a heap bound; use the separate collector tests for overflow enforcement.

commonCdpObservationVerified.evidence: explore-07 P1 and explore-08/09 P0/N raw artifacts; see freezeEvidence.
commonCdpObservationVerified.domain: CDP renderer seconds, before/after bracket includes drain and observation overhead; not page cohort duration.

finalBuildPositiveControlReceipt.binding: External receipt required before formal execution: source commit, plan hash/commit and normal/profile BUILD_IDs. Exploratory positive controls are linked here; no formal build/measurement completion claimed.

draftRevisions.change: Replace initial 16 MiB trace wording with 200000-event collector cap plus 64 MiB post-run encoded snapshot ceiling; 250 MiB retained artifact budget uses gzip JSON.
draftRevisions.reason: JS object heap is not encoded JSON size; per-frame stringify would distort the measured workload. Preserve actual heap/process observations separately.

draftRevisions.change: Use raw per-profiler callbacks, commitTime windowing, timestamp ambiguity reporting; all modes keep fixture detailed=false; freeze actual-delivery cohort with explicit in-flight handling; document one-port sequential orchestration and profile-then-normal build order.
draftRevisions.reason: Timestamp equality is not a globally unique commit ID; differing fixture tracing would confound P1-P0; pause cannot retroactively erase in-flight input.

draftRevisions.change: Steady S1/S2 drain freezes the delivery cohort without pausing input transport; t1 is the actual observed page-clock boundary, not an assumed exact timer deadline. S4 retains explicit lifecycle pauses.
draftRevisions.reason: Pausing transport during a normal recording drain could trigger RC stale guards and prematurely stop S2, changing the product workflow being measured. Cohort exclusion follows declared delivery time rather than suppressing input.

draftRevisions.change: Require Node TypeScript transform flag; declare common N/P0/P1 CDP endpoint observation with its independent seconds domain and drain-inclusive bracket; retain source-bound exploratory React/browser evidence separately from final-build acceptance.
draftRevisions.reason: CLI compatibility and observer symmetry must be frozen before formal runs. CDP counter brackets and page delivery cohorts have different denominators. Earlier successful exploration cannot certify later fixture/analyzer changes.

draftRevisions.change: Parent runner deadline includes declared cleanup allowance while retaining the 30 min batch ceiling; source identity/clean state checked before each run; artifact accounting covers the entire isolated worktree output/playwright. Add explicit read.batch/parser.frame boundaries and require rebuilt P1 exploratory controls.
draftRevisions.reason: Do not cut off bounded cleanup or hide prior artifacts in another batch folder. Newly added capture observations change the measured workload and invalidate reuse of earlier profiling-build controls.

draftRevisions.change: Freeze protocol after six P1 exploratory scenarios plus two P0 and two N controls; current analyzer reanalysis linked. Keep unavailable ordinary React/GPU fields explicit, retain external self-hash/source/build binding and reserve final batch cleanup.
draftRevisions.reason: Positive controls now establish measurement availability and mode isolation; formal execution still requires the committed plan, exact-source validation and build receipts.

commonCdpObservation.collection: One CDP Performance.enable per page, then one Performance.getMetrics before and after every labelled interval; no full CDP timeline trace.
commonCdpObservation.clockAndUnits: CDP renderer counters have their own timestamp domain. Timestamp and cumulative duration deltas are seconds; heap endpoint sizes are bytes. Do not directly subtract CDP timestamps from page performance.now milliseconds.
commonCdpObservation.interval: The before/after bracket includes the page measurement window, any declared drain, and observation/control overhead. Retain both endpoints and measured CDP Timestamp delta; it is not identical to the delivery cohort [t0,t1).
commonCdpObservation.comparison: Compare same-condition same-repeat N/P0/P1 using common available counters. For renderer task occupancy use TaskDuration delta divided by CDP Timestamp delta, not page cohort duration. Preserve absolute duration and denominators; ScriptDuration is not additive to total TaskDuration.
commonCdpObservation.limits: Renderer counters do not measure whole-process or machine CPU, physical input latency, or a time-aligned per-frame latency. Heap snapshots are endpoints, not a peak or continuous heap bound.
commonCdpObservation.unavailable: Retain available=false with reason and null derived deltas. An unavailable counter is not zero overhead.

browserObserved.gpuUnavailableReason: Not queried; no GPU performance claim

exploratoryEvidence.boundary: This earlier exploratory receipt proves these observations only for its source/diff/plan. Its old valid=true summary must not be treated as acceptance of subsequently changed analyzer/fixture code. Final build positive control remains required; no formal repetitions have run.

captureBoundarySemantics.read.batch: One observation for a reader.read result carrying a value, before done handling; fields batchId, byteLength, done, hookId and connectionGeneration. This counts transport chunks, not RC samples.
captureBoundarySemantics.parser.frame: One observation per frame returned by parser.push for that batch; fields batchId, command, error, payloadLength, hookId and connectionGeneration. Includes non-RC and error frames; a buffered frame is associated with the read batch that completes parsing.
captureBoundarySemantics.rc.decoded: Decoded RC sample observation remains separate and reconciles with independent fixture IDs; parser frame count must not be used as its cohort denominator.
captureBoundarySemantics.positiveControl: Observe read.batch and parser.frame on the rebuilt final profiling source. The earlier build predates these boundaries, so rerun all P1 exploratory conditions before freezing.
captureBoundarySemantics.normalOffBoundary: These product collector events remain unavailable in N/P0; do not invent zero read or parse activity.

externalReceiptBinding.reason: The plan cannot contain its own final commit/file hash. Keep these null and bind the exact frozen plan bytes/commit, tested source commit/tree/file manifest and both BUILD_IDs in external formal build/orchestrator/run receipts. formalExecutionPrerequisites: Commit this frozen plan and complete exact-source checks.
